welcome.title: How should you start learning to drive?
paragraphs: Deciding to learn driving is an important step. When you begin with the right understanding and a clear plan, the process becomes far less difficult.

The first thing to do is look for driving schools near you. Check whether the institution is approved, whether the instructors are experienced, and review the fees and course structure before choosing a school. A good school makes the entire learning experience much easier.

To get a licence, you need to pass two tests. The first is the learner’s licence test, a theory test that checks your knowledge of road rules and signals. After that comes the driving test, a practical assessment of whether you can drive a vehicle safely. With proper practice, both tests can be cleared confidently.

Driving lessons usually happen in two parts. One is classroom learning, where road rules, traffic signals, and vehicle controls are explained. The second is practical driving, where you learn to drive on real roads under a trainer’s supervision. This helps build confidence and correct mistakes early.
If you have limited time, the theory portion can also be studied online from home at your convenience. However, the practical part requires the support of a qualified instructor.
Most importantly, learn to drive safely. Safe driving matters not only for your own protection, but also for everyone else on the road.
